He carried the letter up the stairs, lit the lamp early, and began to write a reply.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市仍在沉睡。路灯投下昏黄的光，空荡荡的街道上只有风掠过落叶的声音。远处，环卫工人挥动扫帚，沙沙声规律而安静。便利店的灯依旧亮着，像一只不肯合上的眼睛。高楼的窗户大多漆黑，偶尔有一两盏亮起，藏着失眠的人或早起的梦。天边泛起一线淡淡的青灰，第一班公交车缓缓驶出车站，城市即将醒来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job, like opening a box that has a smaller box inside.\n- You keep repeating until you reach the tiniest box, which is empty. That is the stopping point, and without it you'd go on forever.\n- Then you go back out, finishing each bigger box in turn, until the whole job is done."}
